title: Replication package for GDOP- and NLOS-aware anchor placement for UWB-TDoA localization in underground parking garages
description: Python code, fixed random seeds and result files that reproduce every table and figure of the article GDOP- and NLOS-Aware Anchor Placement for UWB-TDoA Localization in Underground Parking Garages (Vehicular Communications). The package contains the parametric garage model with a height-aware line-of-sight model, the reference-invariant GDOP objective, binary PSO, GA and SA optimizers, the Monte Carlo TDoA solver, the Cramér–Rao bound and RSSI benchmark, and the accuracy-driven design experiments. All results are simulation-based. See README.md for the mapping from scripts to tables and figures.
